location_fine: shaded picnic grove, then inside a car on a night road
character_types: two young men in baseball caps
visual_synopsis: Two young men in caps park their green Lada sedan in a shaded grove, spread a mat and hold a long boozy picnic with bread and bottles until both pass out on the ground. The sketch then cuts to night, where they drive the same car in panic while a wild-haired screaming figure looms at the windshield and they thrash and yell inside the cabin.
